notes: Network to county sites and the SOS opened about 14:07 UTC; Sabine evidence was gathered after that through the fetch module. The county 'Election Results & Required Postings' page lists precinct-by-precinct PDFs only for 2002 through 2021 plus 2022 official results, and links 'PRECINCT BY PRECINCT ELECTION RESULTS' to http://sabine.easydocs.us/election/, which returned HTTP 403. The Elections page lists, for the May 26 2026 runoff, only 'MAY 26, 2026 PRIMARY RUNOFF OFFICIAL RESULTS' (Official runoff.pdf), a county-wide Cumulative Results Report marked Official Results with Run Date 06/02/2026 (scanned, OCR text). No Nov 5 2024 or Mar 3 2026 result files and no election-night (unofficial) files are listed on either county page today, so nothing shows when, or whether, precinct-level results were posted on election night. Not tagged NO_SITE_OR_SOS_ONLY because the county does post results files on its own site (at least official ones). Contact: TX SOS county election officials list gives Sabine County, County Clerk Jamie Clark, '(409) 787-3786', County Email Address mailto sabine.elections@co.sabine.tx.us; the county Elections page shows 'Phone: 409-787-3786' and 'countyclerk@co.sabine.tx.us' (clerk general email). Wayback probe for the Elections page failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). No WebFetch attempted. No stated change found. Usage notice: none seen, left empty.
tag_rationale: The county site shows only an official county-wide runoff report (run 06/02/2026) and pre-2022 precinct reports; no source shows election-night precinct posting for the three target elections.
